meaning: Replace Clock_InitCESTA call bl 0xA6F4 with mov w0, wzr; retain ClockDxe and its clock protocol initialization
evidence: Clock driver init at 0x795C calls 0xA6F4 at RVA 0x7D3C. Error branch loads string 0x11F0C: Clock_InitCESTA failed. Previous DCD-only call at 0xA810 is nested in this CESTA function; excluding the caller avoids its complete cold reinitialization.
reference_scope: Onyx uses another SoC: precedent for the function-level workaround only. Addresses and bytes are derived from TB520FU.
